title: Output bit specification and work bound
statement: Let $n,\ell\in\mathbb N$, with $\ell>0$, and let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ and binary vectors $r,s$ of length $\ell$ be given. For every coordinate $i<n$, the output bit at $i$ equals coordinate $i$ of the generator vector formed from $r$ and $s$, and its work is at most $16(i+1)(\ell+1)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$
